title: Why am I being charged a fee on my Bronze Account?
summary: Explains why the Bronze Savings Account may show fees: there is no monthly maintenance fee ($0.00) and no minimum balance ($0). Fees only occur via excess withdrawals after 6 per monthly cycle ($3.00 each additional) and/or a $2.00 monthly paper statement fee if enrolled in paper statements.
faqs: Does my Bronze Savings Account have a monthly maintenance fee?
